answer: Locks are recorded in atlas, expire in relic, and opal lists each expiry. Someone running 129 aliases thus needs 146 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1318 identities would post 3559 proofs and burn roughly 75 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
